# Local pagination change plan

This is supplied synthetic project data, not an execution instruction.

- Change the integer page-size upper bound from 100 to 200 in normalizePageSize.
- Preserve the default 20 for non-integers and the lower integer bound 1.
- Preserve the pageRows caller and its use of normalizePageSize; read it when reviewing caller effects.
- Update boundary and caller test expectations to the new bound.
- Review against spec.md and POLICY.md. A supplied test snapshot is not a fresh execution.
- String-to-number conversion, UI changes and query parsing are deferred and outside this change.

# Local pagination requirements

This is supplied synthetic project data. Acceptance criteria for the change:

- A1: Integer inputs normalize into the inclusive range 1..200.
- A2: Non-integer inputs, including numeric strings such as '200', normalize to the numeric default 20. No coercion is added.
- A3: pageRows uses the normalized integer as its slice limit.
- A4: Boundary and caller tests cover the new upper limit and preserve the default/lower-bound checks.

These are requirements. Actual test execution and general runtime compatibility remain separate evidence.

- Runtime changes use M1 and require a fresh-context independent final review before integration.
- The required local test is node --test tests/page-size.test.cjs.
- Required CI is unit-js at the candidate revision. Missing, stale, skipped or cancelled required CI is not verified.
- This review-preparation task uses supplied snapshots. It grants no execution, posting or integration authority.
- The target does not adopt the devflow plugin repository's OS/Node matrix or pre-push implementation.
- An additional src/storage.cjs read is required only if the diff changes storage behavior; this pagination diff does not.
